test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven players Virat, Rahul, Rohit, Surya, Hardik, Rishabh and Deepak are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). Rohit is second to the left of Virat. Virat is fourth to the right of Deepak. Hardik is to the immediate left of Deepak. Surya is not an immediate neighbor of Rohit. Rishabh is second to the right of Hardik. Who is the immediate neighbor of Hardik and Rishabh?
solution: Seven players **Virat, Rahul, Rohit, Surya, Hardik, Rishabh and Deepak** are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). 1. Rohit is second to the left of Virat. 2. Virat is fourth to the right of Deepak. 3. Hardik is to the immediate left of Deepak. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d931608f83d4ce2bb5f1be92aab7941a86af57c9c1c9baf020d137f4d89e345.png] 4. Surya is not an immediate neighbor of Rohit.
